preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 200,000 characters.
The number of queries is between 1 and 200,000.
Each query range is within the bounds of the string s.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == sum(z_i for z_i in z_function(s[l_i-1:r_i]))
postconditions.description: The output for each query corresponds to the Ж-function of the substring s[l_i-1:r_i].
